name: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. Whatever drives them, humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

features.name: Age
features.description: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

features.name: Size
features.description: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common.

features.name: Humanity's Hope
features.description: When you take the Prepare move during a rest with another companion, the other may gain an additional Heroic Inspiration.

features.name: Versatile
features.description: You can choose an additional Origin Feat.
